description: Generate a schema.org JSON-LD snippet (Organization, LocalBusiness, Product with Offer, or FAQPage) from your details, with placement tips, so search engines and AI assistants can identify the entity. Use when adding structured data to a page. Do NOT use to check whether a site already has structured data (use check_ai_readiness) or for llms.txt (use llms_txt_draft).

address.description: Optional street address for local_business, e.g. 100 Main St, Austin, TX 78701.

name.description: Entity name, e.g. Reddy Plumbing (required; not emitted for faq).

price.description: Optional price for product; a 3-letter currency code in it sets priceCurrency (default USD), e.g. '49.00 USD'.

questions.description: Question/answer pairs for faq (at least one required when type is faq).

telephone.description: Optional phone for local_business, ideally E.164, e.g. +1-512-555-0100.

type.description: Entity type: organization, local_business (adds telephone/address), product (adds price Offer) or faq (requires questions).

url.description: Canonical page URL including https://, e.g. https://example.com (required; not emitted for faq).

name: schema_jsonld_sample

disclaimer.description: Informational disclaimer: crawler behaviour can change, verify against provider docs.

jsonld.description: Pretty-printed JSON-LD object as a string, ready to embed.

placement.description: Where to paste the snippet in the page.

title: Generate JSON-LD sample
